title: Find the total favorite count of all posts that were modified in 2011 by us
question: Find the total favorite count of all posts that were modified in 2011 by users who both (a) posted at least one comment with a score below 60 and (b) earned at least one badge in 2011.

prediction.sql:
SELECT SUM(p."XCL_039")
FROM posts AS p
WHERE p."XCL_042" >= '2011-01-01'
  AND p."XCL_042" < '2012-01-01'
  AND p."XCL_033" IN (
    SELECT c."XCL_010"
    FROM comments AS c
    WHERE c."XCL_007" < 60
    INTERSECT
    SELECT b."XCL_002"
    FROM badges AS b
    WHERE b."XCL_004" >= '2011-01-01'
      AND b."XCL_004" < '2012-01-01'
  )
